# fix-lu4-disconnect-win

Lu4 Windows disconnect — NIC power-save/offload (Ethernet PC or WiFi notebook).

## Human doc

README.md — short RU guide: manual ncpa.cpl steps + optional Apply/Rollback scripts.

## Scripts (2)

- Apply-Lu4EthernetNic.ps1 — read → snapshot → surgical known-good
- Rollback-Lu4EthernetNic.ps1 — restore snapshot previousValue only

-Media Auto|Ethernet|WiFi. Snapshot: %LOCALAPPDATA%\fix-lu4-disconnect-win\snapshot-<GUID>.json

## Success

E-Net OFF → Black → Recommended → Black in Servers → OK only → character select.
